en: Color postcard showing a spa/resort complex with a long white building with red-tiled roofs set in a green park with tall conifer trees; people are strolling and sitting on the grass. The reverse reads in Romanian with printed headings "CARTE POȘTALĂ," publisher "EDITURA MERIDIANE," and a caption "BORSEC," plus price and credits. There is a handwritten Romanian message and an address to a soldier in Câmpina, Prahova.
